changelog: Fixed CMB parser to include neutrino density parameter
Enhanced default CMB wrapper to return TT, TE, EE spectra
Improved covariance matrix reader endianness and header validation
Updated documentation and cosmo_model_guide.json for CMB support
Added unit tests for CMB spectrum generation and plotting
